system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 2 lbs. Power Points 10; Recharge 1 per day.

Six silver bands encircle this dark wooden rod. Each is engraved with a different traditional symbol for the mortal soul.

Activate You attempt a Counteract check against possession, a Soul-trait effect or an effect forcibly binding, controlling or displacing a soul.

Action Free

Expend 2 PP from the rod to gain a +2-item bonus to the triggering Counteract check.

The rod also briefly vibrates when within 5 feet of a possessed creature.

On the sheet: held, the rod offers +2 item for 2 PP on a Spellcraft check — take it on a Counteract against possession or a Soul effect. Its vibration near a possessed creature is a note.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

checkBonus.scope: a Counteract check against possession, a Soul-trait effect or an effect binding, controlling or displacing a soul
